title: Better Than Takeaway Sweet & Sour Pork
description: Golden, crispy pork with a sticky, tangy sauce — exactly what you want when you skip the takeaway.

ingredients.notes: divided: 15ml for Stir-Fry, 500ml for Deep Frying

method.instruction: In a bowl, marinate pork with soy sauce, white pepper, and five spice. Let sit for 15–20 minutes.
Combine plain flour and cornflour in a bowl. Beat the egg in a separate bowl.
Dip each piece of marinated pork in beaten egg, then coat thoroughly in the flour mixture.
Heat 500 ml of the vegetable oil for deep frying to 170–180°C in a wok or deep pan. Fry pork in batches until golden and crispy, about 5–6 minutes per batch. Drain on paper towels.
For the sauce: mix together tomato sauce, brown sugar, and white vinegar in a small bowl. Set aside.
Heat the remaining 15 ml of vegetable oil in a clean wok or large frying pan over high heat. Stir-fry onion and capsicum for 2–3 minutes until slightly softened but still crisp.
Add garlic and carrot. Stir-fry for 30 seconds until fragrant.
Pour in the sauce mixture. Bring to a simmer and cook for 2–3 minutes until slightly thickened.
Add crispy pork pieces and toss quickly to coat in the sauce. Serve immediately over steamed rice.

notes.title: Keep It Crispy
notes.content: Add the pork to the sauce at the very last moment and serve immediately. The longer it sits in the sauce, the softer the coating becomes.

notes.title: Double Fry
notes.content: For extra crispy pork, fry once at 160°C, let rest for 5 minutes, then fry again at 180°C until golden.

notes.title: Add Pineapple
notes.content: Fresh or canned pineapple chunks add authentic sweetness and texture. Add them with the vegetables in step 6.
